project.name: WoGu Temporal
project.description: Temporal Java SDK rules for WoGu (WG001-WG003 today), most of them declared as YAML definitions under src/main/resources/rules and executed by the generic ForbiddenMethodRule, so adding a "flag this static method call" rule requires no Java code. Contains the reusable CallGraphAnalyzer engine, the WorkflowImplementationScanner, and the RuleRegistry/RuleDefinitionLoader pipeline those declarative rules are built on. Analyzes project source with JavaParser; has no compile-time dependency on the Temporal SDK itself, since detection is source-based.
